open_points.subject: service_invoker.prepare_request input contract
open_points.text: "Inputs: A ManifestOperation M10 with instance facts ..." ... "Enforces ... no selected instance (no name), no `api_base_url` (a name without one)"
open_points.question: How does `prepare_request` receive the selected instance *name* (needed to distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing`) if its declared inputs include only ManifestOperation-with-facts?
options: Pass `selected_instance_name` as a separate explicit input to `prepare_request`
Encode selection state inside ManifestOperation (e.g., explicit enum) and stop returning name separately
Do not distinguish the two failures and collapse to one detail

open_points.subject: effects operation-element addressing
open_points.text: "Inputs: A run, node and element." and "Trusts the facts `runs` passes down (State 3) and checks none of them again."
open_points.question: What exact fields identify "node and element" for `effects.reach_operation_element` and `effects.operation_element_conclusion` (node_id only, node_id+map_index, plus binding_id/effect_class, etc.)?
options: Use (`run_id`,`node_id`,`map_index`) only; `effects` re-reads node definition from flow version
Pass a fully resolved operation-node descriptor (binding_id, effect_class, map_over metadata) from `runs`
Pass both identity tuple and resolved descriptor and require consistency
open_points.default_guess: Use (`run_id`,`node_id`,`map_index`) and have `effects` read node details from the pinned flow version.

open_points.subject: bindings.check_installed_instances service scope
open_points.text: "per service, the selected manifest instance name and one credential" ... "Enforces: No credential header has ... the name of a required header of its instance ..."
open_points.question: At start, does `check_installed_instances` validate services with no selected instance, and should an unreadable manifest record for such a service stop startup?
options: Validate only services that have a selected instance; unselected services are skipped
Validate all configured services regardless of selection
Validate header-name collision against kernel-set headers for all services, but manifest-required-header collision only for selected instances
open_points.default_guess: Validate only services with a selected instance.

open_points.subject: error contract classification of internal_error
open_points.text: "An operation either returns its output or refuses with one code of the closed set below" and later "`internal_error` is not a refusal"
open_points.question: Is `internal_error` part of the refusal channel or a separate non-refusal result class for module APIs?
options: Treat `internal_error` as a refusal code like others
Treat `internal_error` as a separate error class outside refusals
Use separate class internally, but surface maps it into the same wire error envelope
open_points.default_guess: Use a separate internal class and map it to the surface error envelope.

open_points.subject: SpooledFile record identity vs lookup identity
open_points.text: M22: "Identity: value" / "Substitution: equal facts are the same spooled file." versus State 5: "A SpooledFile ... is named as `read_spooled_file` says" with identity fields only (`run_id`,`producer_node_id`,`map_index`,`attempt_number`,`producer_port`,`list_index`).
open_points.question: Is the canonical identity of a SpooledFile the full fact set (value identity) or the positional tuple used by `read_spooled_file` and store lookups?
options: Define the positional tuple as the sole record identity; digest/size/media_type are attributes
Define full-facts identity and add a separate unique positional key for lookup
Keep both as equivalent and require invariant that positional tuple determines full facts uniquely
open_points.default_guess: Use positional tuple as record identity and treat other facts as non-key attributes.
